question: For each instructor, list their name, the number of unique courses they teach, the total number of material assignments, average publication year, and number of distinct status, sorted by the number of unique courses in descending order.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "library_course_instructor" AS SELECT library_course_instructor_key, course_name, instructor_name, department, date_from, date_to, unit_code, unit, warehouse_load_date FROM beaver."LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR"
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "library_reserve_matrl_detail" AS SELECT library_course_instructor_key, library_reserve_catalog_key, library_subject_offered_key, library_material_status_key, term_code, subject_id, warehouse_load_date FROM beaver."LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL"
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "library_material_status" AS SELECT library_material_status_key, library_material_status_code, library_material_status, warehouse_load_date FROM beaver."LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS"
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "tip_detail" AS SELECT tip_subject_offered_key, tip_material_key, tip_material_status_key, term_code, subject_id, isbn, record_count, warehouse_load_date FROM beaver."TIP_DETAIL"
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "tip_material" AS SELECT tip_material_key, isbn, title, author, edition, publisher, year, new_shelf_price, used_shelf_price, rental_new_price, rental_used_price, material_info_source FROM beaver."TIP_MATERIAL"
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "library_course_instructor" AS SELECT library_course_instructor_key AS library_course_instructor_key, course_name AS course_name, instructor_name AS instructor_name, department AS department, date_from AS date_from, date_to AS date_to, unit_code AS unit_code, unit AS unit, warehouse_load_date AS warehouse_load_date FROM beaver."LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR"
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "library_reserve_matrl_detail" AS SELECT library_course_instructor_key AS library_course_instructor_key, library_reserve_catalog_key AS library_reserve_catalog_key, library_subject_offered_key AS library_subject_offered_key, library_material_status_key AS library_material_status_key, term_code AS term_code, subject_id AS subject_id, warehouse_load_date AS warehouse_load_date FROM beaver."LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL"
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "library_material_status" AS SELECT library_material_status_key AS library_material_status_key, library_material_status_code AS library_material_status_code, library_material_status AS library_material_status, warehouse_load_date AS warehouse_load_date FROM beaver."LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS"
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "tip_detail" AS SELECT tip_subject_offered_key AS tip_subject_offered_key, tip_material_key AS tip_material_key, tip_material_status_key AS tip_material_status_key, term_code AS term_code, subject_id AS subject_id, isbn AS isbn, record_count AS record_count, warehouse_load_date AS warehouse_load_date FROM beaver."TIP_DETAIL"
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "tip_material" AS SELECT tip_material_key AS tip_material_key, isbn AS isbn, title AS title, author AS author, edition AS edition, publisher AS publisher, year AS year, new_shelf_price AS new_shelf_price, used_shelf_price AS used_shelf_price, rental_new_price AS rental_new_price, rental_used_price AS rental_used_price, material_info_source AS material_info_source FROM beaver."TIP_MATERIAL"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE tmp_courses AS
SELECT
  lci.instructor_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lci.course_name) AS unique_courses
FROM library_course_instructor lci
GROUP BY 1;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE tmp_assign AS
SELECT
  lci.instructor_name,
  COUNT(*) AS total_material_assignments
FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lrd
JOIN library_course_instructor lci
  ON lrd.library_course_instructor_key = lci.library_course_instructor_key
GROUP BY 1;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE tmp_status AS
SELECT
  lci.instructor_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(lms.library_material_status, lrd.library_material_status_key)) AS distinct_status
FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lrd
JOIN library_course_instructor lci
  ON lrd.library_course_instructor_key = lci.library_course_instructor_key
LEFT JOIN library_material_status lms
  ON lrd.library_material_status_key = lms.library_material_status_key
GROUP BY 1;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE tmp_pub AS
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    lci.instructor_name,
    tm.year
  FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lrd
  JOIN library_course_instructor lci
    ON lrd.library_course_instructor_key = lci.library_course_instructor_key
  JOIN tip_detail td
    ON td.term_code = lrd.term_code
   AND td.subject_id = lrd.subject_id
  JOIN tip_material tm
    ON tm.tip_material_key = td.tip_material_key
  WHERE tm.year IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT instructor_name, AVG(year) AS avg_publication_year
FROM joined
GROUP BY 1;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT
  coalesce(c.instructor_name, a.instructor_name, s.instructor_name, p.instructor_name) AS instructor_name,
  COALESCE(c.unique_courses, 0) AS unique_courses,
  COALESCE(a.total_material_assignments, 0) AS total_material_assignments,
  p.avg_publication_year,
  COALESCE(s.distinct_status, 0) AS distinct_status
FROM tmp_courses c
FULL OUTER JOIN tmp_assign a USING (instructor_name)
FULL OUTER JOIN tmp_status s USING (instructor_name)
FULL OUTER JOIN tmp_pub p USING (instructor_name)
ORDER BY unique_courses DESC, instructor_name ASC
LIMIT 200;
